newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest sees Telfer profit in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest sees Telfer profit in 1997/98.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd said on Wednesday a review of its Telfer gold mine in Western Australia had delivered a strategy to restore the mine to profitability in 1997/98.
It has also been hit by lower than expected gold production this year from Telfer due to heavier than normal rainfall at the mine site.
Elsewhere, Newcrest said it would spend A$24 million over the next 18 months on a detailed feasibility study into an underground mine at its Ridgeway prospect.
The decision followed encouraging drill results better defining the higher grade zone at the prospect, three kilometres west of its Cadia Hill mine near Orange in New South Wales.
Johnson, who took over as chief executive after John Quinn resigned in May, said the company was assessing funding strategies and expected to make a statement in the September quarter.
